item.title: Apple’s iPhone 18 delayed until 2027—here’s the new launch plan
item.description: Get ready for a shake-up in Apple's iPhone lineup! The base iPhone 18 is taking a backseat until spring 2027, as Apple shifts gears to spotlight Pro and foldable innovations. Welcome to a new era of staggered launches.
